After connecting your prepared USB drive

This illustrated guide is for AI Drive Offline 0.10.1-usb.2. These are illustrations, not actual screenshots. Keep your drive connected while chatting.

  1. Open AI Drive Offline. Tap Choose USB memory folder. Select USB drive → Android-Drive-Kit, then Use this folder → Allow. Wait for Drive connected and a verified save.
  2. Tap Choose a model, the document-plus icon, then Use External Model. Select USB drive → Android-Drive-Kit → models → Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-abliterated.Q4_K_M.gguf.
  3. In the bottom Settings tab, set Max Context to 2048. Return to Models, tap the circular play button and wait for Model Loaded.
  4. Go Back to Drive Memory, tap Chats → AI Bot, type a message and tap Send.
  5. Open Drive Memory → Save and disconnect, confirm and wait for saving. If the model stays loaded, use Chats → menu → Models and its red X to unload it. Use your phone’s Eject option if available, then unplug the drive.

For a quick local tool check, use Drive Memory → Offline Toolkit, choose the calculator example and tap Run tool. The result is (12 + 8) * 3 = 60. That calculator does not require the Llama model to be loaded.

See START-HERE.txt for memory, notes, reconnecting and help. The separate Earlier-Illustrations-usb1.pdf is the older guide.

The app opens manually; drive insertion does not launch it. No account or subscription is needed for this local model.
